Objections · Handled

Frequently Asked Questions

Is this the RadioReach Vault, or do I need the Vault too?
This is the command layer. The Vault gives you 18,000+ contacts; Frequency Dominion gives you the system that turns those contacts into airplay. If you have the Vault, this is the unlock. If you don't, Module 2 teaches you exactly which stations to buy and how to target them — but the fastest path is Vault + Dominion.
I've never gotten a single add. Will this actually work for me?
This course was built for exactly you. Modules 1–3 build your identity, targets, and weapons before you send a single email. Module 4 runs the campaign. The proof is in the system, not your history — but the standard is the standard: 20 stations, 3 touches, logged.
How is this different from emailing the list myself?
Spamming 18,000 inboxes burns your wells and trains PDs to delete you. This is precision warfare: 20 targets, scored, armed with proof and radio-ready audio before wave one. Fewer emails. More adds. No stench.
How long does it take to go through?
The core course is about 6 hours of content. The 21-day campaign is the real course — one sequence per station, three touches, daily 20-minute blocks. Expect the cycle itself to run three to four weeks. Adds depend on your market, format, and proof: some stations reply in week one, others never do. That is the honest base rate of radio pitching.
What formats and genres does this work for?
College, community, commercial, online, and specialty radio. Format scoring adapts to hip-hop, country, rock, EDM, R&B, Latin, folk — any genre with a station format that plays it. Genre-agnostic; market-specific by design.
What's the refund policy, exactly?
30 days, exactly as printed on the guarantee card above: run the 21-day campaign to the pass standard, log it in your war room, and if you finish with zero replies and zero adds, we refund every cent and you keep the bonuses. Email support@radioreach.us with the log — processed within five business days.
